newsitem.title: USA: U.S. Robotics, Information Resources in alliance.
newsitem.headline: U.S. Robotics, Information Resources in alliance.

text.p: U.S. Robotics Corp and Information Resources Engineering Inc said Wednesday they formed a strategic alliance that includes joint sales, distribution and marketing, as well as possible joint development in the future.
The alliance will offer communications products that allow companies to capitalize on new opportunities in the electronic marketplace, the partners said.

For example, corporate customers using U.S. Robotics/Information Resources products could equip their remote sales forces with mobile secure modems and provide secure remote access to the corporate local area network (LAN) using the Internet, they added.

U.S. Robotics and Information Resources provide complementary products for secure information access for companies and individuals. U.S. Robotics said it also plans to bundle Information Resources' low-cost SafeNet Softy security software with select client modems to support electronic commerce applications.
